shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -60 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" lib/products.ts; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace && node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('react', r.version); console.log('ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition)" 2>&1; echo "--- next's vendored react ---"; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react* -d 2>/dev/null; grep -rl "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/*.js 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -20; echo "--- @types/react version ---"; node -p "require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version"; echo "--- next's own types for ViewTransition ---"; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/*.d.ts node_modules/next/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
cat tsconfig.json && echo "=====canary.d.ts head=====" && sed -n '1,50p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

grep -n "ViewTransition:\|const ViewTransition\|function ViewTransition\|ViewTransition<" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "--- next-env ---"; cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "(missing)"; ls -a | head -20

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && echo "=== HOME grid markup ===" && curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<div class="product-grid".\{0,700\}' | head -c 900 && echo && echo "=== DETAIL hero markup ===" && curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'back-link.\{0,400\}' | head -c 600

echo "=== page-level wrappers ===" && curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<main[^>]*>' && curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div vt-[^>]*>' | head -3
echo "=== forward nav types in payload ===" && curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'transitionTypes[^]]*]' | head -2
echo "=== reveal after resolve (detail) ===" && curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-enter=\\\?"slide-up\|vt-exit=\\\?"slide-down' | sort | uniq -c
curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '"enter\\":{[^}]*}' | head -3; echo "--- exit ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '"exit\\":{[^}]*}' | head -3
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; git status --short && echo "=== files changed ===" && git diff --stat
git status --short; echo "=== diff stat ==="; git diff --stat
